EmailTemplate.description: BT HRS-Reactive HRS Transfer - Send when client is transferring to a new HRS
EmailTemplate.name: BT HRS-Reactive HRS Transfer
EmailTemplate.subject: HRS Transfer
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Attach a client contact sheet
Hello [Client Contact],
I'd like to take this opportunity to make you aware of changes to your Insperity service team. We are realigning resources to better meet your needs as a part of our effort to continue to provide extraordinary service. I am excited to introduce myself as your dedicated HR Specialist and client liaison; you can reach me at xxx-xxx-xxxx and name@insperity.com.
If this is a transition from one BT HRS to another in the same team: [Your Payroll Team, and Manager, HR Services are unchanged.]
If this is a transition from one Business team to another: [Your payroll team is unchanged; the new Manager, HR Services is [ ]
I have attached your Insperity Service Team contact sheet for your convenience. Note also that I work in a team environment; if I am unavailable and you require urgent assistance, please reach out to one of my colleagues by emailing our team at team@insperity.com or via the team line at xxx-xxx-xxxx.
I would like to schedule a call to discuss your company's needs and the HR solutions that Insperity can continue to provide to your business. I am available on [dates available]. Please let me know if one of these dates will work for you or suggest an alternate time.
We thank you for your continued business; I look forward to our partnership.
With regards,
